import json, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from wire import v, envelope, stream, crypto, datagram, trace

CLASSES = '/workspace/tmp/classes'

def run(traces):
    inp = json.dumps({"traces": traces})
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py',CLASSES], input=inp.encode(),
                       capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print(p.stderr.decode()[:2000]); raise SystemExit(1)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def show(res):
    print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
EOF
